remarks: Beautiful move in ready 2-bedroom, 2-bath unit in a gated, highly desirable Torrance Harbor Manor complex, located directly across the street from Harbor UCLA Medical Center. This unit has all new interior paint, new lighting fixtures, new window coverings, resurfaced tile countertops in kitchen and bathrooms, upgraded electrical outlets and switches professionally replaced throughout. This property has a desirable, open floor plan layout, with a wet bar for entertaining. Laminate, vinyl, and tile flooring throughout, kitchen has a brand new, farmhouse style sink and new faucets.
